description_for_human: Turn a script, voiceover, or slideshow into a finished narrated video. Generate images, video clips, voiceovers, sound effects, music, and talking-head avatars.
description_for_model: Use VideoGen to generate videos and media. The core surface is end-to-end video workflows (script-to-video, voiceover-to-video, slideshow-to-video, prompt-to-video-clip, storyboard-to-video) at POST /v1/workflows/*, which return a workflowRunId to poll at GET /v1/workflows/runs/{workflowRunId} until status is succeeded, failed, or cancelled. Standalone asynchronous media tools at POST /v1/tools/* return a toolExecutionId to poll at GET /v1/tools/executions/{toolExecutionId}. Export a finished project to MP4 via POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/export. All ids are opaque prefixed strings (e.g. vg_work_...); all numeric timestamps are seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).
